# Refund Policy

## 1. Cancellation
Members can cancel at any time with 30 days notice. The notice period starts on the day the cancellation form is
received at reception or by email.

## 2. Refunds
Prepaid annual memberships are refunded pro rata, minus an administration fee of 25 EUR.
Monthly memberships are not refunded for the current month.

## 3. Medical exceptions
If a member cannot train for medical reasons for more than 4 weeks, the membership can be paused without a fee
when a doctor's note is provided.
